card.name: Dose amounts and units in dosing text
card.fires_on: Digits and unit pieces (mg, mcg) that finish a dose amount in dosing instructions, tables and ranges. It responds most where the number or unit closes the quantity.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit mg or mc(g) right after a dose number, often in a range or table.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose number
modes.description: A digit partway through or ending a multi-digit dose value.
modes.example: Fosamprenavir 700 mg twice daily plus ritonavir 10<<0>> mg twice daily.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a dose amount, such as 25 mg, is being completed in dosing text.
